tui.title: BugHunter TUI workbench
tui.desc: Terminal graphical entrance for authorized security testing: first confirm the target and boundaries, and then start the inspection.
tui.mode_quick_desc: It only does information collection and basic risk identification, which is suitable for understanding the target for the first time.
tui.mode_standard_desc: Information collection + Risk discovery is recommended by default and high-risk verification is not actively performed.
tui.mode_deep_desc: To verify the risk more deeply, the scope of authorization needs to be reconfirmed.
tui.mode_continuous_desc: Multiple rounds of continuous operation, suitable for shooting ranges or long-term observation of targets.
